[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[File:Urban 1.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = In-game screenshot | ingame name = Bukdek Byway | game link type 0 = explorable | game link num 0 = 240 }} [[Bukdek Byway]] is a densely populated area of [[Kaineng City]], with several levels of housing and confusing passages to navigate. The southeastern corner is controlled by the [[Am Fah]] of [[the Undercity]] while the [[Jade Brotherhood]] holds sway towards the northeast. The [[Afflicted]] have some presence in the center of the area. ==Getting there== [[Factions]] [[character]]s will travel north from [[the Marketplace]] through here on their way to [[Kaineng Center]] for the first time. Non-Factions [[character]]s will be required to leave Kaineng Center and travel through this area as part of the [[primary quest]] [[Welcome to Cantha]]. Many [[secondary quest]]s take place here. ==Exits== *[[Kaineng Center]] (north) *[[Shadow's Passage]] (northeast, only after the completion of the [[Vizunah Square]] mission) *[[The Marketplace]] ** [[Eliminate the Jade Brotherhood]] ** [[Finding The Oracle]] ** [[Missing Daughter]] ** [[The Afflicted Guard]] ** [[Welcome to Cantha]] *{{Vanquisher|count = 135|low = 63|high = 228}} ** If [[Chasing Zenmai]] is active, there are several ways you can get credit for vanquishing by killing fewer than 10 foes (depending on your starting outpost), since that quest allows you to enter a section initially devoid of any foes. [[Party]] members must not have [[Eliminate the Am Fah]] or [[Eliminate the Jade Brotherhood]] active. *** With [[The Afflicted Guard]] active, only one kill is needed (start from [[Kaineng Center]]). *** With [[The Drunken Master]] active and with ''The Afflicted Guard'' inactive; to get credit for the vanquish, you only need to defeat [[Drinkmaster Tahnu]] (if you start from Kaineng Center). *** With neither of those active, take the [[Missing Daughter]], which spawns around 10 foes. *** Without those three quests active, you can still reduce the kill count to less than 60: approach [[Bryan]] from the west, but send only heroes and henchmen to him; do not let any players get within compass range. Defeat the three Jade Brotherhood groups that this triggers and clean-up the remaining mobs on the eastern side of the area (do not venture further west, as this will trigger additional foes, potentially raising the required number to the default). *** Any party members that have completed [[Cleansing Bukdek Byway]] must also take [[Memories of Purity]]. ** [[Initiate Zei Ri]] will help you vanquish if you have the quest [[Cleansing Bukdek Byway]] (or [[Cleansing Bukdek Byway (Hard mode)|its hard mode equivalent]]) active, but only until the last [[Afflicted]] is killed. == Trivia == * There are at least two ambient animals in the area: ** A napping cat, curled up near the shrine of [[Balthazar]] (southeast exit to [[the Undercity]]) that will occasionally flick its tail or stretch itself; it was modeled after [[Linsey Murdock]]'s pet. ** A dog, resembling a [[w:pug|pug]], in a trough up the left staircase after exiting [[Kaineng Center]]. * [[The Naked Man]] could be found here during early beta. {{Explorable areas in Kaineng City}} [[de:Bukdek-Seitenweg]]
